limits: GetSystemMetrics is scripted; cases model screen dimensions without measuring a live display.
GetCursorPos is scripted and writes an eight-byte screen POINT; the owned poll does not consume that POINT.
GetAsyncKeyState is scripted; cases distinguish the low-word held-key and press-edge bits without claiming live keyboard input.
SetCursorPos is scripted; cases record screen-coordinate warps without moving a real cursor.
joyGetPosEx is scripted with the original 52-byte JOYINFOEX buffer and success or failure results.
joyGetDevCapsA is scripted with the original 404-byte JOYCAPSA buffer and success or failure results.
joyGetNumDevs is scripted; device discovery is not hardware acceptance.
The original x87 integer-conversion callee executes unchanged; no game routine is replaced by a fixture.
Bounded source and binding cases do not establish application startup, window/client conversion, menu behavior, or live input integration.
notes: Boundary reviewed against pinned v1.0 whole-function disassembly and startup callers. Source allocation is 0x248 bytes; binding owner allocation is 0x90 bytes. Detailed layout, partial initialization, branch ledger, EAX-consumption evidence and case guidance are in the ignored packet NOTES.md. No coverage exemptions or shortened owned intervals.
